from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    key = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
    if not key:
        return g
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in key), max(r for r,c in key)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in key), max(c for r,c in key)
    pattern = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    # Rotate the small color pattern clockwise.
    rotated = [list(row) for row in zip(*pattern[::-1])]
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 8]
    a0, a1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    b0, b1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
    kh, kw = len(rotated), len(rotated[0])
    # Each pattern cell corresponds to an equally sized block in the 8-shape.
    sh, sw = (a1-a0+1)//kh, (b1-b0+1)//kw
    for r,c in cells:
        i, j = (r-a0)//sh, (c-b0)//sw
        if i < kh and j < kw:
            g[r][c] = rotated[i][j]
    return g
'''
p=base/'task-560fd64a.py'; p.write_text(code)
print(p)
